title: Connection tokens
text: For an explicit connection token, run yoke tokens create --name ci as yourself and pass the one-time value through yoke connect <server> --token-stdin or --token-file PATH. Local tokens work only on their computer; use yoke self-host init for a shared server.
note: UI launch/status output contains no sign-in tokens in text or JSON. Human terminals open browser admission directly; agents and unavailable browsers receive a named reason and human-terminal recovery. Source review commands also print only bare URLs; an explicit fixture token preserves automated review.
